## Cardinalities in finite monoids of G-equivariant functions

Ramón H. Ruiz-Medina

Centro Universitario de Ciencias Exactas e Ingenierías , Universidad de Guadalajara, Guadalajara, México.

## Abstract

set with a group action is referred to as a G-set, and the set of functions that commute with this action forms a monoid under function composition. This paper examines the case where the G-set is finite,  which implies that the monoid of G equivariant functions is also finite. The document provides formulas for calculating cases of Gequivariant functions; known as elementary collapsings. All of these results are expressed in terms of specific properties of the G-set, including the number of orbits and certain indices of the subgroups acting as stabilizers. special fixing

Keywords: Group actions; G-sets, G-equivariant function, cardinality.
